items.look_for: In the checkbox column, every box has a solid gray border on HEAD. The PHP, Dart, Java and Swift rows gain a half-opacity box where base shows none.
At the right edge, the four "Unavailable" notes are a darker, readable gray (#babacb to #8c8c9d).

items.note: No visible change is claimed (the rows became real checkboxes for screen readers). Nothing in this pair belongs to it. Leave it to a gate or a code read.
